virtualTable.name: semafor_AGGREGATED
virtualTable.sql:
SELECT m.quadrant_name, (SELECT id FROM atlas.record_validation_status WHERE priority=max(status.priority) LIMIT 1) AS max_valid_status, ST_Multi(ST_Union(m.q_polygon)) as geom, tree.parent_id as pladias_id
FROM pladiascz.m_plants_distribution m, atlas.record_validation_status status, public.m_descendant_taxons tree
WHERE tree.descendant_id = m.taxon_id AND m.validation_status=status.id
GROUP BY m.quadrant_name, tree.parent_id
